title: Second Order WinoBias (SoWinoBias) Test Set for Latent Gender Bias Detection in Coreference Resolution

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the difference in performance of coreference resolution systems on pro-stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical sentence pairs (using WinoBias for explicit bias and SoWinoBias for latent/second-order bias), alongside embedding-level metrics such as single-attribute WEAT, clustering/recoverability, and Gender-based Illicit Proximity Bias (GIPE).
